Here's what I found — and what I didn't:

**Figure available: No.** The XBRL snapshot in this environment doesn't carry Walmart's R&D expense.

**What I checked:**

| Tool | What I tried | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `filings__lookup_company` | "Walmart" → WMT, CIK 104169 | Confirmed identity |
| `filings__get_company_facts` | All facts for WMT | Only 2 concepts exist: `CostOfRevenue` and `InventoryNet` |
| `filings__list_available_concepts` | WMT's available concepts | Same two — no R&D |
| `filings__get_company_concept` | `ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense` + 5 variants (Policy, Costs, ComputerSoftware, etc.) | All returned "concept not in snapshot" |
| `filings__get_xbrl_frames` | `ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense` for FY2022–FY2025 | All returned "no facts for that concept/period" |
| `filings__full_text_search` | "Walmart research and development expense 2025" | 0 hits |
| `docs__search_documents` | "Walmart R&D research development" | 0 matches |

The snapshot only holds `CostOfRevenue` ($511.8B for FY2025) and `InventoryNet` ($56.4B at Jan 31, 2025) for Walmart. R&D expense simply isn't in the dataset — I can't pull a figure that the tools don't have.
